name: Leovelo
priceNote: Five-day one-to-one frame-building course from €1,200 plus materials (approx. €500 for a Columbus Zona tube set)
summary: Workshop on the Lower Rhine that builds custom steel frames, starting from a bike fit and a geometry sketch, and runs five-day one-to-one frame-building courses. Recent builds include 32-inch steel hardtails.
uncertain: Street address not yet confirmed on the business's own site; location and website from a job posting and directory listing.

sources.name: BIKE: Leovelo custom steel frame in 5 days
Job listing, Leovelo Zweirad Meisterbetrieb, Grefrath

name: Patria Fahrräder
summary: Family-run manufacturer in East Westphalia that designs, brazes, paints and assembles steel frames in-house and offers made-to-measure bikes. The Patria brand dates to 1898.
uncertain: Sources name different towns in East Westphalia (Leopoldshöhe, Oerlinghausen, Bielefeld); Leopoldshöhe is from the most recent factory report (2025). 1898 is the origin of the brand, not of the current company.

sources.name: Bike Insights: 2025 Patria Tribos geometry (cites patria.net)

name: Schicke Mütze
summary: Gravel and road bike shop in Düsseldorf city centre that builds bikes to order on framesets such as OPEN's MIN.D and WI.DE. Bike fitting is provided with partner MotivAktiv, who works from the shop's second space on Oststraße.
uncertain: Bike fitting is provided by a partner working from the shop's second space. Street address only in a dealer directory.

name: Radsport Frankfurt (Gnewikow & Fülberth Radsport GmbH)
summary: Road and gravel specialist in Frankfurt-Eschersheim, trading since 1983, that sells custom and kit-built bikes from Colnago, Pinarello and OPEN. Riders buying a bike are measured on a fitting device to set frame size, saddle height and stem length.
uncertain: Street address only in dealer directories.

name: Rheintritt
summary: Workshop in Düsseldorf combining a bike repair service with frame building. Builds made-to-measure steel and titanium frames, welded or brazed, for cyclocross, gravel, road and hardtail riding, plus its own Ruffy trail model and stainless-steel Joytime city bikes.

name: Krabo
summary: Frame workshop in Bochum-Harpen building frames to order since 1977, in steel and aluminium, for road racing, triathlon, track and touring/trekking use, as frames or complete bikes. Magazine lists refer to this Bochum builder by the owner's family name, Krautscheid.
uncertain: custom-paint inferred from 'lackiert' option on the homepage; not verified as in-house.

name: Marschall Framework
summary: One-man frame shop founded in Dortmund in 1992 and based at Möhnesee since 2000. Builds lugged, brazed and polished stainless-steel frames, made to measure or in standard geometries, including the Alamo road frame and randonneur frames, and restores, repaints and modifies steel frames of any make.

name: Finnbar Trout Cycles
summary: Köln builder making custom steel frames, lugged or fillet-brazed, with Columbus and Reynolds tubing; work includes road, allroad, gravel and café-racer bikes. Offers frames, steel forks, paint and complete builds.
uncertain: Website footer still shows 2021; activity inferred from Bespoked Dresden 2025 coverage (The Radavist).

name: Le Canard Rahmenbau
summary: Frame building operated within the Balance bike shop in Bochum. Builds made-to-measure steel (25CrMo4) frames, mostly fillet-brazed with Columbus or Reynolds tubing; riders are measured at the shop. Also runs supervised courses in which customers build their own frame.
uncertain: Founding year not published; riders are measured and geometry checked on a sizing rig at Balance (no named fitting system).

name: Agresti
summary: Frame builder in Offenbach am Main making custom frames in steel and titanium, using Columbus, Dedacciai and Reynolds tubing, and repairing steel, titanium and aluminium frames by TIG welding, brazing or replacing damaged tubes.
uncertain: Site is JS-rendered; disciplines not stated on fetched pages. Aluminium listed by magazine for new frames; own site confirms aluminium only for repair.

name: SeLi Rahmenbau
summary: Frame workshop in Dörrenbach (Pfalz) building custom steel and stainless-steel frames, lugged or fillet-brazed, for MTB, gravel, road, randonneur, track, cargo and kids' bikes, plus forks, stems, racks and Pinion frames. Runs frame-building courses and restores older frames.

name: mawis bikes
summary: Titanium-only builder in Kleinblittersdorf near Saarbrücken. Each frame is a one-off made to the rider's measurements, with options such as Rohloff dropouts, internal routing, T47 or PF30 bottom brackets; portfolio covers MTB, road, randonneur and fixed-gear bikes.

name: Schauff
summary: Bicycle factory founded in Köln in 1932 as a racing-frame maker and based in Remagen since 1945. States in-house frame production (welding and brazed lugged frames), painting, wheel building and test lab; current range centres on tandems, trekking, heavy-duty and folding bikes and the steel Rheinische Manufaktur line.
uncertain: Not verified which current models use frames welded in Remagen versus sourced; frame materials beyond steel not stated; no custom-geometry offer found.

name: Tannenwald Bikes
summary: Small steel-frame brand from Roschbach near Landau (Pfalz), co-founded by the owner of the Grand-Raid bike workshop. Makes TIG-welded steel frames built individually to order, including MTB hardtails, gravel and road models and the Vogelfrei adventure series.
uncertain: Own website blocks automated access (Cloudflare 403), so Impressum could not be fetched: street/postcode left null (an older blog Impressum lists Kreuzstraße 4, 76835 Roschbach). Who welds the frames (in-house vs. partner) not confirmed; frame production in Roschbach per BIKE magazine. Price from search snippet (Columbus frameset from about EUR 2,180) not verified, so priceNote null.

sources.name: BIKE: Rahmen werden in der EU gebaut

name: LAST
summary: Mountain bike brand founded in Dortmund in 2000; designs hardtail and full-suspension frames in-house and assembles them in its Dortmund workshop. Carbon frames are laminated in Germany by All Ahead Composites near Würzburg; aluminium frames are welded in Taiwan and their bearing seats machined in Dortmund.
uncertain: Borderline fit: only the carbon models are made in Germany, and by a contract laminator outside the region (Bavaria); no custom geometry offered, custom-build refers to configurable component builds.

name: JEDI Sports
summary: Road, gravel and triathlon shop at the Hülser Berg in Krefeld. Carries Pinarello, Colnago, Cervélo, BMC, Look, Wilier and OPEN, and offers custom-assembled bikes built from its parts range to customer specification.
uncertain: Seat-position service with sports scientists is mentioned only in a directory listing, not verified on the shop site; authorised status per brand not confirmed in brand locators.

name: La Bici
summary: Road, gravel and triathlon shop in Düsseldorf-Oberkassel run by a former professional rider. Sells Pinarello and Ridley alongside its own La Bici brand, offers individually configured carbon road bikes with high-end components, and includes a bike fitting with each purchase.
uncertain: Fitting system not named; dealer status not checked against Pinarello/Ridley locators.

sources.name: La Bici: road bikes (custom builds, fitting, brands)

name: Die Edelhelfer Krefeld
summary: Krefeld branch of a five-store NRW bike retailer. Has a Trek Project One custom corner showroom in the store; the group offers bike fitting with Radlabor SmartFit or Retül and runs a weekly gravel after-work ride from the Krefeld store.
uncertain: Store announces a move to Moerser Str. 75b, 47803 Krefeld from 27 October 2026 (closed 20-26 Oct). Which fitting system is used at the Krefeld store is not stated; Cervélo is sold by the group, not confirmed as stocked in Krefeld.

name: Die Edelhelfer Düsseldorf
summary: City-centre Düsseldorf branch of the Edelhelfer group, listed in the Specialized store finder; stocks Specialized, Trek and Cannondale and offers SmartFit-based bike fitting.
uncertain: Cervélo available via transfer from other stores, not stocked locally. Whether Retül is used at this store is not stated.

sources.name: Specialized store finder: Die Edelhelfer Düsseldorf

name: Storck Store Düsseldorf
summary: Factory-owned Storck store in the Düsseldorf Medienhafen offering consultation, test rides and fit checks on Storck road and gravel bikes.
uncertain: No workshop or full bike-fitting service described for this location.

name: magno
summary: Road and gravel shop on the Bilker Allee in Düsseldorf, founded in the city in 1991; carries Colnago, Bianchi and Merida and offers bike fitting and workshop service.
uncertain: Fitting system not named; Colnago dealer status not checked against the Colnago locator.

name: ROCKERS Bikeshop Wuppertal
summary: Wuppertal branch of a three-store bike shop group, listed in the Specialized store finder; MTB-oriented range including S-Works models, with in-house bike fitting and wheel building.
uncertain: Fitting system not named. A directory lists Santa Cruz, not confirmed on the shop site.

sources.name: Specialized store finder: Rockers Bikeshop Wuppertal

name: Zweiräder Biernath
summary: Bike shop in Solingen-Ohligs with a broad range including road and gravel bikes; lists Pinarello and Scott among its featured brands.
uncertain: Large share of the range is e-bikes and city bikes; Pinarello dealer status not checked against the Pinarello locator.

name: Baboon Bikes

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (street level).

summary: Mountain bike and gravel shop in Düsseldorf-Hafen, opened in 2011. Sells Santa Cruz, Yeti, Pivot, Evil and Commencal, and its workshop offers complete bike builds, wheel building and suspension-oriented service.
uncertain: Custom build is listed as a workshop service (Bike-Komplettaufbau), not as a dedicated custom programme; dealer status not checked in Santa Cruz/Yeti/Pivot locators.

name: Radsport Jachertz
summary: Trek retailer in Düsseldorf-Unterbach with a mountain bike and e-MTB focus; offers Trek Project One custom configurations and a workshop.
uncertain: Large share of the range is e-bikes and city bikes.

name: Die Edelhelfer Burscheid
summary: Burscheid branch of the Edelhelfer group in the Bergisches Land; listed as a Trek retailer, with group-wide Trek Project One and bike fitting using Radlabor SmartFit or Retül.
uncertain: Burscheid is in the Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, outside the listed sub-area; may overlap with the Köln/Rhein-Berg agent. Project One and fitting systems are described group-wide, not confirmed for this store.

name: Georgs Fahrradladen
summary: Bike shop in Mönchengladbach-Neuwerk carrying Specialized (including the Tarmac SL8), Scott, Giant and Orbea.
uncertain: Not verified in the Specialized store finder; S-Works/flagship status unknown. Range also includes e-bikes and city bikes.

name: KarlvonDrais
summary: Frankfurt bike retailer with three stores; the Ostend store on Hanauer Landstraße is a Specialized flagship store that also carries Cervélo and is listed by Factor as a retailer. The Ostend site focuses on custom builds and offers Retül 3D bike fitting; general workshop work is handled at the Eckenheim and Sachsenhausen stores.
uncertain: Impressum lists the company seat at Karl-von-Drais-Straße 6, 60435 Frankfurt (Eckenheim store); the address used is the Ostend store address as published on the shop's own store page. Specialized flagship status is as stated by the shop, not checked in Specialized's locator.

name: Bike Rite
summary: Road, triathlon and gravel shop in Bad Vilbel north of Frankfurt with a master workshop. Listed in Cervélo's store locator; also carries Specialized. Builds bikes up from framesets with chosen groupsets and hand-built wheels, and includes a seat-position analysis with each bike sale.
uncertain: Fitting method/system not named by the shop.

name: Radsport Bornmann
summary: Road-focused bike shop in central Kassel, listed in the Pinarello and Cervélo dealer locators and also stocking BMC. Its CustomBorn programme configures bikes from its range with customer-chosen components and colours, and it offers bike fitting with the IDmatch system.

name: Delta Bike
summary: Bike shop in Gießen-Wieseck operating since 1991, with a separate brand store listed in the Pinarello and Colnago dealer locators; also carries Cervélo, Specialized and Scott, with a master workshop.

name: bike-innovations
summary: Road and gravel shop next to Heppenheim station on the Bergstraße. Dealer for Pinarello, Colnago, Factor (test centre) and OPEN, among others, and builds bikes up to the customer's specification; runs a workshop and group rides.

name: Bike FACTS!
summary: Bike shop in Kassel-Kirchditmold with a road and gravel focus. Offers Trek Project One custom configuration and paint, carries Wilier and SEKA, and does appointment-based fitting using a 3D body-scanning system.
uncertain: Name of the body-scanning fitting system not stated by the shop; Colnago (named in a directory) not confirmed on the shop site.

name: Der Radbauer
summary: Bike shop in Gelnhausen (Main-Kinzig) with a mountain-bike and road focus. Listed in the Santa Cruz, Cervélo and Factor dealer locators; also carries Juliana, Norco and Forbidden. Offers Smartfit bike sizing and fitting, custom builds and a suspension service for Fox and RockShox.
uncertain: Dealer locators list Hailerer Straße 1; the shop's Impressum and footer give Am Ziegelturm 4.

name: Auf und Davon
summary: Outdoor retailer in central Fulda with a separate bike shop and workshop focused on gravel, road and bikepacking. Listed by Factor as a retailer; offers bike fitting for gravel, road and triathlon bikes, plus gravel and e-bike rental.
uncertain: Impressum gives Karlstraße 33 (outdoor store); the bike shop is at Karlstraße 34 per the shop's own page. Fitting system not named.

sources.name: Auf und Davon: bike shop Fulda

name: Rad+Triathlonshop Dietzenbach
summary: Road and triathlon-oriented bike shop in Dietzenbach south-east of Frankfurt, listed in Cervélo's store locator; also carries Trek, Cannondale and Cube and offers individual measurement with a bike purchase.
uncertain: Cervélo is listed in the Cervélo locator (as 'Rad + Triathlonshop Neu-Isenburg') but not named on the shop's own partner list.

name: Radsport Smit
summary: Swim, bike and triathlon retailer in Gustavsburg near Mainz with a bike workshop and online shop; listed in Cervélo's store locator.
uncertain: Cervélo dealership taken from the Cervélo locator only; not confirmed on the shop's own site.

name: Radsport Reitz
summary: Bike shop in Wiesbaden-Dotzheim operating for more than 20 years, listed in Colnago's store locator; its brand page also shows De Rosa, Look, Cinelli and Stevens.

name: BIKE-LOFT
summary: Small bike store in central Wiesbaden carrying OPEN, Megamo and ARC8, with consultations by appointment and a workshop; listed on OPEN's retailer list.

name: Wellmann Bikes
summary: Bike shop in Roßdorf-Gundernhausen east of Darmstadt with a master workshop; describes itself as an official S-Works dealer and is listed in the Pivot and OPEN dealer lists.

name: Langenberg.bike
summary: Bike shop with master workshop in Edermünde-Holzhausen south of Kassel. Listed in the Pivot and Santa Cruz dealer locators and runs a custom-bike and 'dream build' service in which bikes are assembled to the customer's choice of components.

sources.name: Langenberg.bike: custom bikes and dream builds

name: Asphalt & Wald
summary: Road and mountain-bike shop in Mühltal-Nieder-Ramstadt south of Darmstadt, at the edge of the Odenwald. Trek store with Project One configuration and a Trek test centre; also sells Ridley. Offers laser-based bike measurement and fitting with SmartFit.

sources.name: Asphalt & Wald: home (Project One, Ridley, SmartFit)

name: Radsport Glock
summary: Family-run bike shop in Marburg's upper town, in business since 1924; Trek dealer offering Project One custom configuration, alongside Giant and Liv.

name: Radsport B&S
summary: Bike shop in Bad Soden am Taunus west of Frankfurt; its brand page lists Ridley alongside Trek, Merida and Centurion, and it is a Shimano Service Center.

name: VanSprint Racing
summary: Road and gravel shop in central Darmstadt that took over the former 'Kreissaal' store in early 2025; it names Cervélo and BMC among its brands, plus Orbea, Cannondale and Trek. Operated by VanSprint GmbH, which also runs a larger general store in Darmstadt.
uncertain: Cervélo and BMC dealership stated on the shop page only; not found in Cervélo's locator. Impressum gives the company seat Pallaswiesenstraße 63, 64293 Darmstadt; the store address is from the shop's own page.

name: velocultour Bikestore
summary: Bike store with master workshop in Neuhof-Dorfborn south-west of Fulda, operating since 2016; listed in the Santa Cruz dealer locator and also sells Orbea and Focus, alongside organised cycling tours.
uncertain: Founding year read from 'Inhaber seit 2016' on the shop's homepage.

name: The Inner Cycle (MG Sport)
summary: Bike shop in Königstein im Taunus listed in Cervélo's store locator under MG Sport GmbH.
uncertain: Website named in the Cervélo locator (inner-cycle.de) does not resolve; address and services could not be verified from the business itself.

name: HIBIKE
summary: Store of the HIBIKE online retailer in Kronberg im Taunus, listed in the Cervélo and Santa Cruz dealer locators.
uncertain: Website blocks automated access, so the Impressum could not be fetched; address left null. A third-party page reports the HIBIKE brand was taken over by Merlin Cycles in 2025 and the Kronberg site re-organised; current store status not confirmed.

name: Breuers Bikebahnhof
summary: Bike shop in the Köln-Longerich S-Bahn station, in business since 1982. Listed in the Cervélo and Santa Cruz dealer locators and as an IDmatch fitting center; sells Specialized including S-Works and offers custom builds on Cervélo and Specialized framesets, with a workshop on site.
uncertain: Specialized dealer status inferred from current-model stock and S-Works custom builds on the shop's site; not confirmed in Specialized's store finder.

name: bikebar
summary: Bike shop and workshop in Bonn-Pützchen listed as an official Ridley dealer in Ridley's dealer locator.
uncertain: Ridley dealer page seen only in search results (it returned HTTP 500 when fetched). The shop's listed website (radladen-bikebar.de) returned HTTP 403/404, so address and website could not be verified on the business's own pages; directories give Adelheidisplatz 8, 53229 Bonn and also mention Pivot, custom builds and wheel building, which are unverified.

name: BOBIKES
summary: Road and e-bike shop with workshop in Köln-Ehrenfeld; official Ridley dealer that also sells BMC road bikes.

name: BPM Proshop
summary: Water-sports, snow and bike store in Aachen listed as a Pivot and Santa Cruz dealer.

name: Cycle WERX
summary: Sports bike shop in Köln-Deutz, trading since 1999 and focused on performance bikes since 2012. Listed as a Factor test center and Colnago dealer; also sells Specialized, Scott and Cannondale. Offers individual builds, with bike fitting provided with partner KomSport.

name: EWERK elektro bikes aachen
summary: E-bike store in the Aachener Kreuz business park in Würselen with a workshop; listed as a Santa Cruz dealer, with a range focused mainly on e-bikes.

name: Radsport Ganser
summary: Road, triathlon and MTB shop in Stolberg-Breinig near Aachen. Authorised Pinarello dealer that also carries Cervélo; offers bike fitting with the Radlabor system and a workshop, and runs a separate children's bike store nearby.

name: Radshop Herfs
summary: General bike shop with workshop in Heinsberg-Straeten, listed in Cervélo's store locator; its brand collections include Cervélo alongside Stevens, Conway and Gazelle.

name: H&S Bike-Discount Megastore
summary: Large retail store in Bonn-Lengsdorf operated by the online retailer H&S Bike-Discount; listed in the Cervélo and Santa Cruz dealer locators.
uncertain: Shop website and Impressum blocked automated access (HTTP 403), so the address could not be verified on the business's own page; the Cervélo and Santa Cruz locators list Auf dem Kirchbüchel 6, 53127 Bonn.

name: Sport Fahrrad Hübel
summary: Family-run bike shop in Bonn-Beuel, open since 1981; Trek retailer that offers Trek Project One custom bikes and runs a workshop.

name: Il Diavolo
summary: Road and gravel shop in Bad Honnef (Rhein-Sieg-Kreis) focused on Italian brands including Pinarello, Wilier and Colnago. Bikes are configured individually with the customer, and a bike fitting is included with every purchase. Workshop service is currently limited to bikes bought or leased there.

name: Radsport Lenzen
summary: Road and gravel shop in central Aachen, trading since 1972, that sells its own Lenzen-branded road bikes and lists Colnago bikes and Colnago and Storck framesets.
uncertain: Colnago dealer status confirmed in Colnago's locator; Storck appears only as a frame category with one listed frame, so Storck dealer status is unconfirmed.

name: MTB-Store
summary: Mountain bike shop in Eschweiler (StädteRegion Aachen), open since 1993 and listed as a Santa Cruz dealer.

name: Portz am Ring
summary: Bike shop and workshop on the Köln ring, open since 1984, with a bike-fitting studio; listed as a Bikefitting.com dynamic-fit partner.
uncertain: The shop's own site describes its fitting studio with SQlab measuring tools and does not mention Bikefitting.com; the Bikefitting.com finder lists it for dynamic fit. No top-tier bike brand verified.

name: Radfieber
summary: Bike shop in Köln's Belgisches Viertel with two workshops in the city and branches in Düsseldorf and Berlin; carries Ridley road and gravel bikes alongside urban brands.
uncertain: Ridley dealer status taken from the shop's own brand page; not confirmed in Ridley's dealer locator.

name: Radladen Hoenig & Röhrig
summary: Bike shop with workshop in Bonn-Beuel, opened in 2001. Listed in the Cervélo and Ridley dealer locators and runs a separate Cervélo road, gravel and triathlon web shop ("Cervélo Rennrad Shop Bonn").

sources.name: Ridley dealer page: Radladen Hoenig & Röhrig

name: Trek Bicycle Aachen
summary: Trek-branded store in central Aachen selling Trek and Bontrager, with Project One custom bikes available to order and a workshop for all brands.

sources.name: Trek: Trek Bicycle Aachen store page

name: Pilgrimm Racebikes
summary: Road, track, MTB and triathlon shop in Münster carrying De Rosa, Basso and Daccordi among other brands. Offers body measurement for frame size and saddle position and builds bikes up individually to the customer's specification. Visits by appointment.
uncertain: Not checked against De Rosa's own dealer locator; brand listing is from the shop's website. Opening by appointment ('Termine nach Absprache').

sources.name: Pilgrimm Racebikes: home (brands, body measurement, custom builds)

name: Go Cycle
summary: MTB-focused shop and online store in Münster; listed Santa Cruz and Yeti dealer offering custom builds and hand-built wheels.
uncertain: The showroom page states the showroom is closed and only pick-ups of web orders are possible (appears to be an old notice); current walk-in access not verified.

name: Velodrom Ottenstein
summary: Road and gravel shop in Ahaus-Ottenstein (Kreis Borken), founded 2022. Listed Colnago dealer since 2026, also carrying Specialized, Cannondale and Orbea. Offers gebioMized pressure-mapping bike fitting for road and gravel bikes, plus workshop service and group rides.
uncertain: gebioMized is not one of the certified systems named in the spec; listed under fittingSystems as published.

name: Heckhuis-Bikes
summary: Bike shop in Rheine listed as Pinarello and Santa Cruz dealer. Fits every bike it sells to the rider using the Smartfit body-scanning system; also sells e-bikes from Coboc, Creon and Velo de Ville.
uncertain: Impressum gives Hansaallee 70; the contact block on the homepage gives Hansaallee 70 B.

name: Radsport Schiffner
summary: Bike shop in Gütersloh founded in 1981 by a former racing cyclist. Listed Pinarello dealer; also carries Specialized in store. Its 'Schiffner Custom' service plans and builds road bikes individually (frame, wheels, groupset, ergonomics), with ergonomic adjustment on purchase.
uncertain: Fitting is described as 'ergonomische Anpassung'; no named fitting system.

name: Radraum
summary: Specialized shop in Bielefeld city centre with Retül bike fitting and a Specialized Service+ partner workshop.
uncertain: The Impressum page renders without content; address taken from the contact section on the homepage and the privacy page. S-Works/flagship status not verified.

sources.name: Radraum: home (Retül fit, Specialized Service+, contact)

name: Liquid-Life Store Bielefeld
summary: Bielefeld branch of the Brilon-based Liquid-Life group; listed dealer for Cervélo, Santa Cruz and Pivot, with Yeti also in the group's range.
uncertain: Which brands are physically stocked in the Bielefeld store (vs. the online range) not verified; Yeti listed by the group but Yeti's locator shows only the Brilon store.

name: Fahrrad Cammer
summary: Road, gravel and triathlon shop in Minden; listed Cervélo dealer, also carrying Argon 18. Basic bike fitting is included with a new bike; premium and triathlon fittings with 3D pedal-stroke and body analysis are offered separately. Sells Cervélo custom-build specs.
uncertain: The 3D fitting system used is not named on the page.

name: Löckenhoff + Schulte (rad1)
summary: Large bike store in Paderborn (part of Lippstadt-based Löckenhoff + Schulte / rad1.de); listed Cervélo and Santa Cruz dealer with seat-position and saddle-pressure analysis.
uncertain: Broad-range store with large e-bike/city share; Cervélo and Santa Cruz only confirmed via brand locators, not on the shop's own brand pages. Fitting details from a directory listing only.

name: Löckenhoff + Schulte (rad1)
summary: Main store of Löckenhoff + Schulte / rad1.de in Lippstadt, a broad-range bike retailer; listed in the Cervélo and Santa Cruz dealer locators.
uncertain: Cervélo locator gives 'Ostenfeldmark 5'; the shop's own pages give Am Mondschein 26. The company traces back to an 1881 hardware business; bike-store founding year unknown. Cervélo and Santa Cruz not confirmed on the shop's own pages.

name: Bike-Milte
summary: vit:bikes shop in Warendorf-Milte with a road and gravel focus around Orbea (including MyO custom paint configurations); fits riders with the Smartfit Q4 laser scanner and offers saddle-pressure measurement.
uncertain: Qualifies on the Smartfit fitting system only; Orbea is not on the top-tier brand list. Sales visits by appointment.

name: Die Fahrrad-Scheune
summary: Bike and e-bike shop in Blomberg (Kreis Lippe), with a second store in Bückeburg; listed in the Cervélo and Santa Cruz dealer locators.
uncertain: Shop's own website emphasises e-bikes and does not mention Cervélo or Santa Cruz; dealership confirmed only via brand locators. Weak performance focus.

name: Powerslide
summary: Bike shop in Minden city centre (sales and repair), listed in Pinarello's dealer locator.
uncertain: No own website found, so street address and website left null (locator gives Marienstraße 20, 32427 Minden). Range and road focus not verified.

sources.name: Teutoburger Wald tourism: Powerslide – der Radladen in Minden

name: 2Rad Seidel
summary: Bike and e-bike shop in Dülmen (Kreis Coesfeld) with a second store in Olfen; listed in the Santa Cruz dealer locator.
uncertain: Own website lists mainly e-bike and city brands (Focus, KTM, Bulls, Gazelle etc.) and does not mention Santa Cruz; dealership only via locator. Weak performance focus; candidate for removal.

name: Fahrrad Rith
summary: Bike shop with a master workshop in Stromberg in the Hunsrück. Lists Factor, BMC and Santa Cruz among its brands and offers individually configured and assembled high-end bikes, with consultation by appointment covering sitting position, geometry and components.

name: Tri Shop Saar
summary: Road, gravel, triathlon and MTB shop in Saarbrücken carrying BMC, Ridley and Cannondale. Runs dynamic bike fitting in its own fitting room (mobility test, saddle pressure mapping, video analysis) in basic, classic and triathlon/time-trial packages; a basic fit is included with a new bike. Also offers wheel building.
uncertain: Fitting uses the shop's own protocol, no named certified system.

name: Camphausen Velo & Café
summary: Bike shop and café in Traben-Trarbach on the Mosel. Listed as a Colnago and Cervélo dealer; its own brand page shows Colnago and Scott. Offers bike fitting in its 'Radlabor' with laser-based body and bike measurement, cleat adjustment and saddle-position setup.
uncertain: Cervélo dealership only from the Cervélo locator (listed under 'Torsten Camphausen Bikes & More'); not shown on the shop's brand page. Fitting system not a named certified one.

name: Fahrrad Heidemann
summary: Bike shop in Trier listed as an authorised Pinarello dealer; also sells road and gravel bikes from Basso and Fuji.

name: Fahrradladen Ramstein
summary: Bike and e-bike shop in Ramstein-Miesenbach (Westpfalz) with a branch in Pirmasens; listed as an authorised Pinarello and Santa Cruz dealer and also sells Trek.

name: B & S – Rad & Fun Sport
summary: MTB-focused bike shop in Schweich near Trier; listed as an authorised Santa Cruz and Pivot dealer and also carries Ridley, Specialized and Cannondale.

name: Radhaus Rödel
summary: Bike shop in Kandel in the Südpfalz; listed as an authorised Santa Cruz and Pivot dealer, with Orbea, Focus and Giant also on its brand page.
uncertain: Santa Cruz locator lists Gartenstr. 6, Pivot locator and the Impressum list Lauterburger Straße 11; Impressum address used.

name: Bikesport Scheid
summary: Bike shop in Lebach (Saarland); listed as an authorised Santa Cruz dealer and also carries Ridley, Specialized, Orbea and Norco.

name: Laufrad racingbikes
